response.rationale: All options map to the same top-ranked leaf 'Acute Myocardial Infarction' with the same relation type and support/confidence scores. Therefore, the ranking is based on the specificity and completeness of the diagnosis provided in each option, aligning with the vignette's details. Option B is the most comprehensive, including mirror-image dextrocardia, acute inferior wall and right ventricular myocardial infarction, and the cause (proximal right coronary artery occlusion). Option D is next, specifying acute ST-elevation myocardial infarction and the cause. Option C specifies acute inferior-lateral ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction. Option A is the least specific, only mentioning right ventricular infarction.
